WEDNESDAY ,THE SEVENTH DAY OF MAY  TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY FIVE  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA  WRIT PETITION NO: 12553/2025 Between:
Viruvuru Pullaiah, and Others ...PETITIONER(S)
 AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
 1. K KOUTILYA Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION

The Court made the following:
 2  NV,J  W.P.No.12553 of 2025 THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA Viruvuru Pullaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh And Others on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31033267/
1  WRIT PETITION NO.12553 of 2025 ORDER:
1.

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, claiming the following relief:
"To issue writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in not paying the compensation to our missing trees in our acquired lands covered by 4(1) notification dated 02-11- 2007 as per the inspection report conducted by the 2nd respondent as illegal, irregular, irrational, violative of provisions of the Land Acquisition Act and offends Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents to pay the compensation for the missing trees as per the inspection report of the 2nd respondent"
2.

It is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the issue in the present writ petition is squarely covered by the order dated 06.01.2023 passed by this Court in W.P.No.32962 of 2018.
3. In view of the same, this Court is inclined to dispose of the present writ petition also in terms of the reasons recorded in the said order.

4. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of, directing Respondent Nos.2 to 4 to take into cosndieration the inspection notes of the Special Collector NV,J (Land Acquisition), GNSS, Kadapa and to pay compensation to the petitioners for the missing trees, if any, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
there shall be no order as to costs.
5. Consequently, miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall also stand closed.
6. Registry is directed to enclose a copy of the order dated 06.01.2023 passed by this Court in W.P.No.32962 of 2018 to this order.

________ JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA Date: 07.05.2025 SP NV,J THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA WRIT PETITION NO.12553 of 2025 Date: 07.05.2025 W SP Viruvuru Pullaiah vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh And Others on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31033267/
